decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using Elves. By utilizing cards like Collected Company to generate extra creatures and Steel Leaf Champion to provide a powerful beatdown presence, this deck aims to quickly build a board presence and deal significant damage. Cards like Shaman of the Pack and Leaf-Crowned Visionary provide additional utility and card advantage to further support the aggro strategy. The deck also includes mana acceleration tools like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to ensure a fast start.

The deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with a mix of flying spirits and tempo plays. By playing efficient threats like Ascendant Spirit and Supreme Phantom alongside disruption spells like Shacklegeist and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to finish the game before the opponent can stabilize. Curious Obsession helps to draw cards and keep the pressure on, while Faceless Haven provides a resilient threat. The deck also includes some utility lands like Otawara, Soaring City to support its aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this aggressive Weenie White deck is to swarm the battlefield with low-cost creatures like Adeline and Thalia, while utilizing cards like Brave the Elements to protect them and boost their power. With a low mana curve and powerful creatures, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of utility lands like Mutavault and Shefet Dunes enhances the deck's overall strategy and provides additional flexibility in combat situations.

The main focus of this Red Deck Wins Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of goblins and low-cost creatures, utilizing cards like Goblin Instigator and Goblin Ringleader to quickly build a board presence. The deck also includes cards like Legion Loyalist and Hobgoblin Bandit Lord to give its creatures additional abilities and power. Den of the Bugbear provides a reliable source of damage, while Mutavault and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance add versatility and reach to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and aggressive, applying constant pressure to outpace the opponent.

This deck focuses on small, low-cost creatures that work together to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes cards that boost the power and toughness of your creatures, as well as protection spells to keep them safe. The deck aims to maintain board presence and deal damage to the opponent consistently, finishing the game before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base includes utility lands that provide additional benefits to the deck's strategy. Overall, the key concept is to be aggressive and efficient in attacking the opponent with a swarm of weenie white creatures.

The primary focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly using cards like Lotus Cobra and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate large amounts of mana, while controlling the board with spells like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Leyline Binding. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells, using cards like Genesis Ultimatum and Koma, Cosmos Serpent to create unstoppable board states. The inclusion of Kenrith, the Returned King provides versatility and additional control options, while cards like Escape to the Wilds and Shark Typhoon offer card advantage and flexibility in different situations.

This control deck revolves around the strategy of utilizing enchantments to control the board while utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes a variety of enchantments to maintain board presence and disruption, along with a selection of versatile creatures that can be fetched with Enigmatic Incarnation to adapt to different situations. The deck's main focus is on controlling the game through a combination of enchantments and powerful creatures to outmaneuver and outvalue the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to use Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels early in the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Valakut Awakening to cycle through the deck quickly and find the necessary combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Magma Opus and Fiery Impulse provide removal and control elements to help the deck survive until it can assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its creativity and firepower.

This mono-red aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with low-cost, efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure to the opponent's life total while utilizing cards like Torbran, Thane of Red Fell and Embercleave to maximize damage output. Anax, Hardened in the Forge provides additional value through creating tokens, while cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel punish opponents for playing spells. With a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a mix of creatures and removal spells to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan. Utilizing powerful cards like Liliana of the Veil and Bloodtithe Harvester, it aims to apply constant pressure while controlling the board with cards like Dreadbore and Fatal Push. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize helps to disrupt the opponent's hand, while cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats to close out the game. The deck also includes lands that provide utility and flexibility to adapt to different situations.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells, removal, and board wipes while generating card advantage and card selection with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils, The Wandering Emperor, and Memory Deluge. The deck also includes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value with blinking creatures and permanents. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck with a mix of utility lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana sources for the powerful spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy utilizing low-cost and high-impact Goblin creatures. By combining cards that boost Goblins like Legion Loyalist and Foundry Street Denizen with powerful attackers like Goblin Piledriver and Hobgoblin Bandit Lord, the deck aims to deal fast and consistent damage to the opponent. Additionally, cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Ringleader provide card advantage and help maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base is optimized for fast and efficient play, with utility lands like Castle Embereth and Den of the Bugbear supporting the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful board state. Liliana of the Veil helps control the opponent's hand while Raffine's Informant and Satyr Wayfinder dig for combo pieces. Can't Stay Away and Witherbloom Command provide graveyard recursion for key cards. Thoughtseize disrupts the opponent's game plan. Esika's Chariot creates tokens to protect the combo pieces. The mana base is set up to support the deck's requirements for colors and lands. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with its synergy.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing damage to the opponent through triggered abilities. The key strategy involves using cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil to consistently sacrifice creatures and ping the opponent. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing opposing creatures to sacrifice or attack with. The companion Jegantha provides additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push while generating card advantage with cards like Village Rites. Overall, the deck is aggressive and proactive, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with constant pressure.
